courses.comparisonText: Mii Tour (2023) recording comparison Archived tour WR: 1:10.37 · kNo2 Mushroom Bridge debuts here. N’s final recovered opening-day result is 1:10.98. N improves to 1:10.71 on May18 and 1:10.69 on May19, NewYork to 1:10.64 on May20, N to 1:10.46 on May21, then kNo2 to 1:10.37 before the May31 reset. kNo2’s previous personal best 1:10.42 has no independently dated original here. The final movie matches its prior sampled assessment; uninterrupted race coverage has not been freshly certified. Lap examples and technique films remain separate.
